tips.text: Start the Chem Lab research chain first and farm Cryotic and Salvage while the timers run.
Budget about 10,000 Salvage if you craft all five Detonite Injectors yourself.
Gather the Cryotic and Salvage before you start the Foundry timer; Cryotic comes only from Excavation and Salvage only from Mars, Jupiter and Sedna.
Nobody complains about this farm; it falls out in the background while the research timers run.
